parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all compounds referenced in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by document ChEMBL ID and require canonical SMILES to be present. Return rows ordered by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
